summary.text: Maya is a new act whose audience aligns with fans of Joanna Sternberg, drawn to introspective, confessional indie folk in intimate settings. This five-city Northeast route targets rooms and support slots where these shared tastes are strongest, from New York and Boston to Burlington, Philadelphia, and Albany.

theme.text: Introspection & Confession: A setlist that opens with vulnerability and memory—songs that invite the audience into intimate moments and reflective emotional landscapes, mirroring the confessional and empathetic tastes of the core audience.

Technology & Society in Folk: A show that weaves together indie-folk instrumentation with subtle commentary on modern life, connection, and identity—themes that resonate with fans interested in how technology shapes honest, introspective storytelling.

Low-Key Intimacy: An unplugged or stripped-back presentation that prioritizes close listening and personal connection, keeping the performance bedroom-session quiet, with minimal production and maximum emotional directness.

merch.text: Cassette tapes or vinyl editions of early recordings, appealing to fans who value lo-fi aesthetics, memory, and tactile engagement with music.

Collaborations with the fashion brands favoured by this audience—tote bags, t-shirts, or patches in the style of Collina Strada, Sandy Liang, or Rachel Comey—bridging indie music and contemporary design.
Handwritten lyric zines or reflection journals, encouraging fans to document their own introspective moments and creating a tangible, confessional artifact from the tour.

risks.text: All suggested opener acts are Qloo recommendations based on shared audience taste; none are confirmed bookings. Each headliner's team must be approached independently, and routing and dates will need to align.

This route assumes Northeast connectivity and does not account for competing shows, seasonal demand, or venue availability. Booking windows, travel logistics, and other touring factors remain outside Qloo's scope.
